Sana Patel: Heads up — were launching a new Dedicated Sales Engineering squad under GTM to better support Dedicated & Private customers. New structure and hires below, doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated-se-revamp :tada:
Priya Natarajan: Awesome — can you call out who will own cross-team runtime handoffs?
Sana Patel: @Priya — Core runtime handoffs will remain with Runtime PMs, but Alex Chen (new hire) will be the SE lead for Dedicated capacity onboarding and will coordinate QA checklists with runtime and infra.
Alex Chen: Hi all! super excited. I start next Monday (remote), will set up 1:1s with @Priya and @Diego next week to sync playbook.
Diego Morales: welcome Alex! we'll share our onboarding runbook and a short shadowing schedule for the CS handoffs.
Maya Reddy: Recruiting update: 2 more SE candidates in onsites this week, hiring timeline target = 6 weeks. @Lizzy tracking the req and offer approvals.
Lizzy Mendoza: Confirmed — finance signoff received for 3 FTEs. I'll open backfill reqs for the current SEs moving into rotation.
Evan Carter: Quick ask — can SE metrics be aligned to Dedicated SLAs? need to report cost/latency impact for sales motions.
Alex Chen: Yes — will propose a dashboard (latency, MTTI, onboarding time) in the playbook.
hirebot: [system] Candidate pipeline: 5 active, 2 onsite, 1 offer pending (candidate 9832).
Sana Patel: Next steps: 1) Alex starts Mon, 2) Maya ramps interviews, 3) Lizzy posts backfills, 4) Priya & Alex publish the runtime handoff checklist by EOW. Q&A session Friday 10am in #all-hands for broader context.
Priya Natarajan: Thanks team — will bring an ops checklist draft to the Q&A.
Diego Morales: +1 to Friday AMA. Also will ping CS leads to share real customer cases for onboarding rehearsals.
Maya Reddy: Putting interview slots on calendar now.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — excited to get going. :rocket:
